Tuṇḍikera : m. (pl.): Name of a people.

At the end of the eleventh day of war, Tuṇḍikeras and Mālavas, along with Sudhanvan, took oath to kill Arjuna 7. 16. 18-19; they are mentioned by Saṁjaya among those who were killed during the first seventeen days of war

.
